meaning: The mass fraction of gas within the gas and oil that enters here. Enter -1 and OLGA takes the equilibrium value from the PVT table.
The mass fraction of total water in the whole fluid at the boundary. Enter -1 and OLGA takes it from the PVT table. WATERFRACTION is the alternative to this key.
The mass fraction of free water in the whole fluid at the boundary. TOTALWATERFRACTION is the alternative to this key.
